LanguageData.DMSL_AerialSupport_NuclearStrike.label: Nuclear Strike
LanguageData.DMSL_AerialSupport_AttackAircraftBombing: Order Sparrow to execute a bombing run. Provide two coordinates; Sparrow will drop five small bombs along the line between them.
Order Tempest to execute a bombing run. Provide two coordinates; Tempest will drop ten large bombs along the line between them.
LanguageData.DMSL_AerialSupport_CarpetBombing.label: Carpet Bombing
LanguageData.DMSL_AerialSupport_CarpetBombing.descrip: Order Longbow to execute a carpet bombing run. Provide two coordinates; Longbow will drop thirty high-explosive bombs along the line between them.
LanguageData.DMSL_AerialSupport_StrafingRun.label: Strafing Run
LanguageData.DMSL_AerialSupport_StrafingRun.descripti: Order Sparrow to execute a strafing run. Provide two coordinates; Sparrow will strafe the path between them with autocannon fire.\n\n(If you have CE loaded, this support will be replaced with attack aircraft bombing.)
LanguageData.DMSL_AerialSupport_ToxGas.label: Drop Tox Gas
LanguageData.DMSL_AerialSupport_ToxGas.description: Drop a large tox gas bomb on the target location, creating a tox gas cloud within a 30-tile radius.
